description: Shared Renovate behaviour for the zdiemer repos. NO minimumReleaseAge, deliberately: it wedged. The preset nulls statusCheckNames because this PAT has no Commit-statuses permission (a 403 on the status POST aborts the whole run), and with internalChecksFilter at its default of 'strict' Renovate holds any update whose release age it cannot confirm — no branch, no PR, just a line under 'Pending Status Checks' on the dashboard that nobody reads. Ten updates sat there, including cloudflared 19 days after release against a 3-day soak, and paperless-ngx a full major behind. internalChecksFilter: none makes the remaining gate explicit: majors need dependency-dashboard approval, everything else opens a PR and waits for a human. Restore the soak only alongside Commit-statuses RW on the PAT.

git-submodules.description: sync-submodules.sh owns submodule pointers; Renovate must never race it

packageRules.description: First-party images: build.sh/upgrade.sh own these, and sync-submodules.sh's pin-advance predicate depends on tag == deployed
DB engines under live data: two-week soak before a PR appears
DB majors never auto-PR — dashboard approval only
All majors gated behind the dependency dashboard during initial rollout; loosen per-repo once trust is earned
GitHub Actions bumps grouped into one PR per repo
